messages:
alice: Heads-up — PRs touching quantization evals are failing in GH Actions but look fine on Buildkite. Anyone seen similar?

bob: yep, saw that earlier. failing step is `eval-runner:setup-deps` with timeout. buildkite uses our bigger agents so it usually finishes there. gha runners hit the 6-10 min job limit for some installs.

carlos: fwiw we intentionally split: GH Actions for PR smoke/gating, Buildkite for full nightly evals. problem is our PR matrix exploded (6 models x 3 quant levels x 2 modes). GH Actions queues too many parallel jobs and some time out.

dana: can we shrink the GH matrix to a minimal smoke set? one representative model + one quant level, run the small eval set (200 prompts) and check the scoreboard. full eval stays in buildkite/nightly.

alice: yes, that's the short-term fix. but we also need artifact parity: GH should upload the small-run outputs so buildkite/nightly can re-run with the same golden prompts if needed. how do folks want to pass artifacts? gha artifacts or s3?

erin: recommend central S3 bucket + short-lived signed URLs. GH Actions uploads smoke artifacts to s3://redwood-ci/evals/pr-artifacts/<sha>/ and Buildkite can fetch when needed. avoids GHA artifact size limits. here's a minimal action for the smoke job: 

```yaml
name: eval-smoke
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  smoke:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, gha-eval-cpu]
    strategy:
      matrix:
        model: [gptj-6B-rep]
        quant: [8bit]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'
      - name: Install deps (cache)
        run: ./ci/install_eval_deps.sh
      - name: Run smoke eval
        run: ./evals/run_smoke.sh --model ${{ matrix.model }} --quant ${{ matrix.quant }} --out out.json
      - name: Upload to S3
        run: aws s3 cp out.json s3://redwood-ci/evals/pr-artifacts/${{ github.sha }}/out.json --acl private
```

bob: note `runs-on: self-hosted` — we need a tiny pool of self-hosted GHA runners for CPU and a separate pool for GPU (gha-eval-gpu) if we want parity for quantization effects. GH hosted doesn't provide GPUs.

carlos: agreed — the main regressions we hit are quant-vs-cpu inference differences. some quant codepaths are GPU-only. if GH smoke is CPU-only we might miss issues. but we can still gate on functional regressions and let buildkite full runs catch deeper numeric diffs.

dana: also seeing duplicate workflows on push+open PR sequences that create duplicate records in test_dashboard. can we dedupe by commit SHA and PR number?

erin: yes, we'll add a small dedupe step: if artifact exists at s3://redwood-ci/evals/pr-artifacts/${{ github.sha }}/out.json then skip. also will add `X-Invocation-ID` to uploads to help correlate.

bob: about gating — we should expose a lightweight status check `eval-smoke/gha` that posts pass/fail. eval-bot can then post a digest in the PR and to #eng-ml. also enforce required check in branch protection for main.

alice: can we define a clear threshold file so GH doesn't flip on tiny noise? e.g. evals/thresholds.yaml with allowed delta per metric and a flakiness allowance.

erin: yes — put thresholds in repo under `evals/config/thresholds.yaml` and eval-bot reads it. sample: `perplexity: 0.02, exact_match: -0.01, flakiness_window: 3` (strings in yaml). eval-bot will treat small oscillations as non-blocking unless it crosses the configured severity.

bob: one operational note — GH Actions sometimes runs two workflows for the same commit (push + workflow_dispatch). we should make the required check be the last completed status for that commit_id, not the first. also add a short TTL on artifact entries to avoid stale re-reads.

carlos: long term idea: move heavy numeric comparisons to a dedicated eval service (post-PR) that consumes s3 artifacts and runs full evals in k8s/GPU via Buildkite, then writes a canonical report to S3/DB. PR gating remains smoke-only.

dana: sounds good. can we also add a test that exercises quantized model loading path (fast, single-batch) in GH smoke? that should catch most glaring deserialization issues.

erin: action items from infra side:
- stand up small self-hosted runner pool for gha-eval-cpu and gha-eval-gpu (spot for GPU)
- add s3 artifact dedupe + invocation ID
- add branch protection required check `eval-smoke/gha`
- create PR template that warns contributors about long eval changes
I'll open infra PRs and ping y'all.

alice: awesome. can someone open a short PR to shrink the matrix and add the s3 upload step? I'll take the thresholds file.

bob: i'll open the matrix-slim PR (ci/gha: reduce matrix + introduce smoke script).

eval-bot: Scheduled nightly: full-evals/buildkite at 03:00 UTC. Will fetch PR artifacts from s3 and compare nightly baselines. Logs will be at https://ci.redwood.infra/evals/nightly/1935016789 (placeholder). :gear:

alice: thanks — let's keep PR noise low and iterate. :thumbsup:
